source_instruction: i am looking for 3mp motion detection security camera.
query: I spent the whole weekend out back pulling up the thick, stubborn patches of crabgrass that’ve been creeping in along the edge of my back porch step all summer, and I swear I must’ve startled half a dozen tiny toads that were hiding out in the damp clumps of soil when I raked the thatch up. I even dragged out my old foldable patio chair to sit for a minute halfway through, and ended up watching a pair of cardinals hop around the bird feeder I hung off the oak tree at the yard edge for nearly twenty minutes before I remembered I still had half the weeding left to finish. I also noticed last night that a couple of the neighborhood raccoons have been tipping over the small trash can I keep by the back gate again, leaving crumpled food wrappers scattered all across the mulch bed I spent three weekends laying down back in April. Hey there, I’m browsing through your video surveillance section looking for a camera that comes with built-in heat signature detection, since that’s the main feature I care about for keeping an eye on my back porch. I don’t have super strict specs beyond that key feature, I’m not too fussed about the little granular details like exact sensor resolution as long as the footage is clear enough to make out faces if someone comes up to the door. I’m only looking for options that are reasonably priced, nothing that stretches my budget too far for what I need. Can you pull up the picks that fit what I’m after?
